sub_graphs.title: ALT_BN128 Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas pricing for BN128 precompiled contract operations

nodes.label: Gas Available for Precompile
nodes.description: Gas forwarded to precompile call

nodes.label: Charge 6000 Gas for MUL
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost for BN128 scalar multiplication

nodes.label: Calculate Pairing Gas
nodes.description: Compute: 34000 * (input_length / 192) + 45000

nodes.label: Pairing Gas Calculated
nodes.description: Variable gas cost determined based on input pairs

ambiguities.text: The specification uses OutOfGasError for invalid inputs, which conflates input validation failures with actual gas exhaustion
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume OutOfGasError is the canonical way to signal precompile failure regardless of cause. The caller cannot distinguish between invalid input and gas exhaustion.

ambiguities.text: Behavior when input is shorter than expected (e.g., < 128 bytes for add) is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume short inputs are zero-padded to expected length, following Ethereum convention for precompile inputs.

ambiguities.text: The term 'subgroup order check' is used without specifying the exact order value or verification method

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying elliptic curve arithmetic library correctly implements BN128 operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect curve arithmetic could allow invalid proofs to verify or valid proofs to fail, breaking ZK verification.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find points on the curve that are not in the correct subgroup but pass validation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Subgroup attacks could allow forged pairing proofs.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BN128 discrete log problem is computationally hard
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If ECDLP is broken, all cryptographic guarantees of the precompiles are void.

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas costs accurately reflect the computational complexity of operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mispriced operations could enable DoS attacks by calling underpriced precompiles repeatedly.
